description: This file contains C++ source code implementing classes and functions related to a plugin service in the WPEFramework, including request handling, service notifications, file serving, and network interface querying.

classes.name: PluginHost::Request
classes.description: Represents a request in the plugin host, managing request state and associated service.

classes.name: IShell::Job
classes.description: Represents a job within the shell, with a static create method.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Handles web service requests, notifications, and network interface configurations.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class for network interface settings.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Clear
methods.description: Resets the request state and releases the associated service if valid.

methods.name: PluginHost::Request::Service
methods.description: Sets the service state based on error code and service validity.

methods.name: IShell::Job::Create
methods.description: Creates a new job instance associated with a shell.

methods.name: Service::Notification
methods.description: Sends a notification message to all registered channels.

methods.name: Service::FileToServe
methods.description: Serves a file over HTTP, with support for default index and safe path validation.

methods.name: Service::IsWebServerRequest
methods.description: Checks if a request segment matches the web server's configured prefix.

methods.name: Config::IPV4UnicastNode
methods.description: Determines the IPv4 unicast node address for a given network interface name.
